messages:
marta: seeing a weird sustained freq drop on a subset of eu-west-2 nodes, started ~10:12UTC. tail latency up and a bunch of spillovers into dedicated pools. suspect noisy-tenant but thermal graphs also spike.
kevin: thanks — can you paste the short gputop and node temp? any MIG share on those nodes?
marta: gputop snapshot: \n```
GPU0: util 98% (tensor 80%), perf: P2->P1 drop, clock 900MHz -> 600MHz, temp 86C
GPU1: util 15%, temp 55C
```
several noisy ML jobs pinned to GPU0 via share-policy. MIG not used.
priyanka: infra-bot shows repeated local-cooling-throttle alerts for rack r-12. autoscaler also spun up two spill nodes at 10:18.
infra-bot: [alert] cooling:thermal_throttle r-12:gpu0 count=6 start=2026-03-20T10:12:14Z actions=[spawn_spill_nodes, mark_noisy_candidate]
kevin: ok. likely tenant A running heavy mixed-precision kernels hammering tensor cores -> thermal hotspot -> perf fallback -> requests spill. Can we live-migrate that tenant to dedicated-slice temporarily?
marta: we can. estimated impact: tenant A has 30k tokens/day, if moved to dedicated.small it'll cost ~+$1.2k/mo vs current shared cost. also will free noisy neighbor pressure.
thomas: product note: tenant A is on trial enterprise; losing perf would hurt conversion. moving to dedicated for a few hours makes sense.
priyanka: quick plan: 1) pin tenant A to dedicated pool eu-west-2-dedicated-temp for 2h, 2) throttle their tensor concurrency by runtime flag (prefactor 0.75), 3) schedule rack-cooling check with hardware ops. rollback path: unpin -> drain dedicated -> return.
marta: config I will push: \n```
route.variant: dedicated-eu2-temp
runtime.flags: tensor_concurrency=0.75
rollout: canary 10% -> 100% in 3m
```
canary at 10:30?
kevin: start canary. I'll watch p50/p95 and node temps. infra-bot, please create a billing estimate for temporary dedicated carve.
infra-bot: [action] created ticket #INC-4219, billing-estimate: tenantA dedicated.small 72h ~ $150. ops-runbook: see runbook "thermal-hotspot-mitigation" for steps.
ops-runbook: runbook steps ACKed. HW ops pinged for r-12 cooling check (oncall: @thomas). ETA 45m.
priyanka: also, add a routing rule fallback: if p95 generation > 900ms for 2m, fallback to quantized-variant and alert oncall.
marta: canary at 10:30 -> 10:33 shows clocks stable -> 900MHz recovered to 1400MHz on GPU0, temp dropped to 72C, p95 dropped from 1.2s -> 320ms. moving to 100% now.
kevin: nice. thermal alerts muted. spill nodes decommissioning. keep dedicated carve for 12h and bill later.
thomas: filing postmortem blurb: noisy-tenant should have an automated thermal cap policy to avoid rack-level hotspots; ops to consider thermal-aware placement across racks.
priyanka: agreed. follow-ups: add tenant telemetry flag, automated dedicated-carve suggestion when sustained per-socket tensor util >85% for 5m, and cost-notify to account for immediate billing impact.
marta: leaving notes in the tenant config and customer ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:
kevin: great work. marking thread resolved unless someone objects.
ops-runbook: [note] scheduled hardware check completed at 11:05 UTC, fan replacement not required."
